title: Group Fitness Class Passes: when a pack lapses and its remaining credits are forfeited
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for when an unused pack lapses and its remaining credits are forfeited, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
A pack lapses, and any credits remaining unused in it are forfeited, once the current moment is not earlier than the pack's purchase date plus the tier's expiration window, counted as whole calendar days from the purchase date with no rounding down of a partial day. The purchase date on the system record for that specific pack is the anchor point this window is measured from; equality — the current moment landing exactly on the day the window completes — is enough to satisfy this basis, and a pack does not need to be even one day past that point.

## Boundary cases
Take a pack whose tier sets an expiration window of some whole number of days, purchased on a given date. On the calendar day that is exactly that many days after the purchase date, the pack has lapsed under this basis (the boundary is inclusive: reaching the day is enough). On the calendar day immediately before that day, the pack has not yet lapsed, because the current moment is still earlier than the purchase date plus the window.

## Points of judgement
- "Full calendar days with no partial-day rounding" means a day that is only partly elapsed still counts as a whole day toward the window; the count is never fractional.
- This basis governs only the lapse itself and the forfeiture of unused credits that follows it; it does not by itself describe how a lapsed pack is later closed out administratively.
